review: Chapter text reviewed and existing study implementation inspected. Advancement, learning, maintenance and transformation requirements are enumerated. Partial mappings identify related study code only; teacher provenance, scheduling and other integration details still need implementation. Cross-reference and arithmetic audits remain open.

entries.acceptance: Keep unspent awards available indefinitely and exclude them from character point value; spending transfers value from the available bank into traits exactly once.
An eligible new positive trait consumes its ordinary cost and increases character value by the amount spent.
Charge the difference between resolved new and old costs for an eligible leveled improvement, not the full new cost or a flat per-level estimate where modifiers alter pricing.
An eligible removal of a negative trait consumes the original awarded magnitude and increases character value accordingly; preserve the original purchase record for later repricing.
Increasing an attribute or secondary characteristic charges its applicable per-step cost, obeys profile limits and updates the same owned profile.

Attribute changes propagate to derived characteristics and dependent skills without separately charging those derived improvements; health +1 yields fatigue +1 and speed +0.25, with movement changing at the applicable boundary.
A strength increase does not automatically increase adult height; optional weight changes and childhood growth remain authored physical changes without invented point rebates.
Permit adventure-point purchase of a learnable advantage only when the campaign judges the experience equivalent to its required training.
An event-granted positive trait changes character value but consumes no adventure points and grants no spendable points; identify the event so replay cannot award it twice.
An event-imposed negative trait lowers character value but creates no compensating spendable points or free replacement abilities.
A permitted refusal of an event-granted advantage leaves both trait state and spendable points unchanged; refusing a benefit does not convert it into points.
A campaign-approved later removal of an event-imposed disadvantage requires the applicable points and world event; it must not assume that event acquisition originally credited the point bank.
Convert each spent bonus point to 10% of average campaign starting wealth, with an authorized windfall reason; credit inventory currency and debit points once.
Charge the difference in skill or technique investment needed for the requested level; the 200-learning-hour equivalence explains awarded points and must not also advance calendar time.
Adventure-point improvement eligibility identifies significant use during the adventure that earned those points; saved points retain enough award provenance to apply the campaign decision.
A new skill requires a qualifying default attempt or spending most of the adventure around sustained use by others, plus the campaign decision; mere catalogue availability is insufficient.
A new technique may be purchased after significant use of its parent skill in the relevant adventure; validate its ordinary prerequisite and cap independently.
Record a stressful default attempt as a possible learning opportunity regardless of success; a skill without a default cannot create this opportunity.
At the beginning of the next session, permit the intelligence learning roll once for a qualifying opportunity; it expires if more than one session passes.
Apply +5 for first-level memory or +10 for photographic memory to the pressure-learning intelligence roll, with mutually exclusive levels rather than additive bonuses.
After a successful learning roll, spend exactly one point earned in the previous session to acquire the skill; no available eligible point means no learning, and a failed roll grants no training.
Expose an authored award with session identity, amount, recipient and reason; ensure duplicate awards are rejected and preserve provenance for subsequent spending eligibility.
New allies, contacts and patrons require an identified relationship earned in play; payment for hired services alone does not establish the corresponding trait.
New rank, status, clearance, legal or religious authority requires an identified grant by a qualified authority, with any prerequisite course, service or payment represented separately.
Require a qualifying deed or body of work before permitting reputation purchase; record its audience and recognition properties through the social module.
Bind a new protected-equipment trait to an actual acquired suitable item; trait purchase alone must not fabricate another inventory copy.

Require residence in and access to the higher-technology society's education and conveniences; imprisonment or isolation does not qualify. Expose the suggested one-level-per-year restriction as a campaign option.
Require accumulated money equal to the new wealth level's starting wealth after relevant payments; changing the wealth trait must not grant that starting money again.
entries.implementation_note: Campaign module supplies RpgExpandedWealthAdvancement: target cash threshold, authored settled-obligations evidence, point difference, owned receipt and unchanged money. Tests unrun; continuation and employment obligations pending.

entries.acceptance: Disallow routine post-creation purchase of inborn physical or mental advantages; a campaign exception names its qualifying revelation, ordeal, transformation or other event.
Removing a dependent requires an authored explanation of the relationship change plus the trait buyoff; preserve relevant world actors rather than deleting them automatically.
Permanent removal of an enemy trait requires both the world resolution and point buyoff; a defeated enemy can otherwise return or be replaced under authored campaign decisions.
Permit eligible mental problems or offensive habits to be overcome at their original point value with the campaign's world justification.
Specify available treatment, technology or supernatural intervention, time and costs; distinguish a temporary mitigating device from permanently removing the disadvantage.
Require a demonstrated change of social position or society before charging the original disadvantage buyoff; points alone cannot remove the social condition.
Record a campaign decision on whether the triggering default attempt was stressful, including event and skill identity; do not treat every failed default as a qualifying opportunity.
Support learning ordinary skills, spells, techniques and eligible advantages through their own investment and prerequisite rules, without converting study credit into unrestricted adventure points.
Award one point of target investment per 200 effective learning hours, carry fractional credit forward and make preview pure; each award updates the same training ledger once.
An elapsed hour contributes to only one study subject unless a specific source or authored exception applies; concurrent owned tracks cannot double-claim the interval.
Study does not require bonus-point awards; account for actual age, calendar time and applicable costs while training, including periods between played adventures.
Credit employment only toward skills actually used in that job, with an employment record and qualifying hours; possessing a skill is not proof it was used at work.
Every four qualifying job hours produce one learning hour; preserve partial-hour credit without rounding each action into a full hour.
For full-time employment, at most eight worked hours each day count toward job learning even if actual work lasts longer.
For part-time employment, at most four worked hours each day count toward job learning.
Honor skill-specific restrictions and prerequisites that prevent self-teaching, including restricted instruction and required mastery traits; a generic study permission cannot bypass these.
Two qualifying self-study hours yield one learning hour, with fractional credit carried across study actions.
Self-study time cannot overlap adventuring, work, meals, sleep or personal care; use the shared time ledger and explicit schedule records.
Apply the twelve-hour daily self-study guideline for an unemployed learner through the campaign's declared scheduling policy.
Apply the eight-hour daily self-study guideline for a learner with a part-time job.
Apply the four-hour daily self-study guideline for a learner with a full-time job.
Each qualifying hour of professional instruction yields one learning hour; ordinary scheduling generally permits eight instruction hours per day.
Verify the instructor's actual teaching skill is at least twelve; an unrelated caller-supplied number cannot establish teaching competence.
The instructor qualifies by having either at least the learner's current subject skill level or at least the learner's invested points; do not require both for ordinary instruction.
Represent semester and night-school courses as schedules whose actual credited hours determine awards; the approximate one-point examples are not extra automatic grants.
Each intensive-training hour yields two learning hours; ordinary intensive scheduling can last up to sixteen hours per day.
Intensive instruction requires teaching skill at least twelve and both strictly higher subject skill and strictly more subject investment than the learner.
Require the intensive course's lavish materials and expert instruction before crediting its doubled learning rate.
Quadruple all applicable training costs and tuition for intensive instruction; debit agreed fees once through the shared currency ledger.
Require effective health at least twelve to complete intensive training without washing out; include the applicable fitness bonus.
An instructor teaching a learnable advantage must possess that advantage; ordinary skill-level comparisons are insufficient for this target type.
Eligible advantages use the same 200-learning-hours-per-point rule and the relevant study mode, with accumulated investment buying the actual trait rather than an unrelated skill.
Spell instruction uses ordinary intelligence-skill learning with spell prerequisites and qualified instruction; rarity changes teacher availability, not the spell's base skill pricing.
Spell self-study requires literacy and suitable books; expose a specific campaign slowdown for difficult texts rather than granting the ordinary rate unconditionally.

After finding a suitable martial instructor, an authorized mastery course takes 1d+1 game-years away from ordinary play, may require authored final tests, and grants the designated mastery trait plus twenty points restricted to allowed special skills.
The campaign may treat mastery-course skill points as ordinary study gains or balance them with equal-value disadvantages; do not additionally put the twenty points into the unrestricted bank.
Declare accessible instructors, subjects, schedule and terms, including barter or services. Instructor availability alone does not waive qualification checks.

An authored adventure-learning award specifies target, qualifying interval and effective learning rate; protect against duplicating ordinary study or bonus-point investment for the same claimed award.

Distinguish source hard caps from recommendations described as usual or rare; an exceptional course needs explicit scheduling policy rather than silently exceeding or universally forbidding those recommendations.
At technology seven or higher, realistic military simulation can teach combat reflexes; below that level the campaign can require fighting experience and bonus points instead.
Time in a foreign land contributes four hours per day toward the local cultural familiarity even while otherwise occupied; this is a specific exception to subject exclusivity.
The same foreign residence contributes four hours per day toward the local language as well as cultural familiarity; preserve language-mode and literacy rules from the character module.

Only the first memory-advantage level is learnable through the specified daily practice or apprenticeship; one hour a day requires the corresponding accumulated learning time and does not grant photographic memory.
Learning enhanced defenses requires the specified unarmed or weapon mastery trait and follows martial-training eligibility.
Either fitness level may be acquired through exercise alone or with a trainer, using the relevant ordinary learning rate.
Qualify gravity experience through visits to different gravity fields or suitable advanced gravity-manipulation training; identify the fields experienced rather than granting universal adaptation.

Mental-power academies may teach eligible abilities and talents under the power acquisition rules. Resolve the narrower wording about talent acquisition here against B254-B255 explicitly; do not silently remove latent characters or assume a new-family permission.
Use the dedicated instructor, long-duration course and completion rules for the two mastery advantages; ordinary hourly skill purchase alone is insufficient.
Skill maintenance is a campaign option disabled by default; enabling it creates owned use/practice and due-check records without retroactively inventing missed checks.

After at least six months without use or practice, schedule an intelligence check, then repeat for each further six-month inactive period. Define calendar months through the campaign time model, not an unexplained constant number of seconds.
Use +5 for first-level memory or +10 for photographic memory on a maintenance intelligence check.
Apply -2 if the maintained skill was learned through intensive training; retain enough training provenance to determine when this applies.
On failure reduce skill by one level and remove the corresponding investment points from character value, without crediting the spendable point bank.
A degrading one-point skill becomes untrained/default-only and cannot degrade further; do not force a negative investment or erase unrelated prerequisites silently.
A skill strictly above controlling attribute+10 is subject to daily maintenance checks when neither used in the field nor practiced for an hour that day.
The hour of practice that avoids an extreme-skill daily check consumes time but earns no study credit.
Once the skill drops to attribute+10, switch to ordinary maintenance intervals and avoid an extra daily check from stale scheduled state.
Body modifications present before play use normal character-point pricing; their artificial origin alone neither changes point price nor requires an additional creation-time cash charge.

Under a point-priced modification policy, debit the required points; insufficient points follow an explicitly selected failure, equal-value replacement or debt policy rather than silently granting the trait.
Permitted modification debt is a negative unspent balance; all subsequent bonus awards repay it before becoming spendable, without suppressing the granted traits or altering their purchased value.
Under a cash-priced policy, debit the agreed currency and adjust character value for the new traits without also charging bonus points; enforce the procedure's recovery and failure outcomes.
An involuntary transformation uses event-acquired trait accounting: adjust character value without spending or granting bonus points.

Surgery requires one recovery day per character point of traits added or removed; preserve the priced component changes used to establish this duration and expose recovery restrictions through health state.
Apply -1 to surgery skill for each full week of required recovery; test the boundary immediately below and at a full week.
A critical success halves required recovery time while retaining the successful trait changes and agreed cost accounting.
Ordinary success grants the intended modifications with normal recovery; effects and recovery belong to persistent owned records.

A failed surgery grants no intended modification, requires normal recovery, and damages the affected body part by recovery-weeks divided by two dice. Resolve fractional dice through verified shared damage rules rather than inventing a rounding convention.
A critical failure doubles the failed-operation damage and requires an authored complication decision with specific resulting disadvantages or consequences.
When cash pricing applies, use 1000 currency units per character point of traits added or removed, with the same auditable change basis used for recovery.
Operations on brain, eyes or vital organs triple both recovery time and cash cost; include this in the recovery-dependent skill penalty and failure damage.
Permanent supernatural modification has no surgical recovery period; preserve any independently specified prerequisites or costs.
When charging cash for supernatural modification, the authored price is at least twice the equivalent surgical price; record fees or donations once.
Instantly granted skills use the selected modification payment policy and actual skill investments; any compensating mental traits or quirks are explicit changes, not implicit discounts.
Temporary skill loading from modular abilities follows the modular trait's allocation rules instead of permanent modification or ordinary study grants.
A mind transfer replaces strength, dexterity, health, their dependent secondary characteristics and physical traits with those of the receiving body.
Ordinary mind transfer preserves intelligence, will, perception and mental traits; retain skill investments and recompute their levels from the resulting attributes.
Recalculate value after transfer; replacing a baseline body with one-arm disadvantage by a two-armed body with strength, dexterity and health twelve increases value by 100.
Apply the selected modification policy to voluntary transfer, using the change in value; involuntary transfer normally adjusts value without a bonus-point payment.

An explicit brain-dependent campaign option changes intelligence, will and perception by the difference between old and new ancestry modifiers; ancestry intelligence +1 to -5 reduces intelligence by six and value by 120.
Support the separately chosen option to apply the ancestry-difference transfer model to dexterity; do not activate it merely because the mental brain-dependence option is enabled.
A dormant backup reserved for use after death is a suitably modified extra-life trait with the chosen cash or point policy, not an automatically active duplicate character.
Maintain a backup snapshot and explicit update schedule, fees and failure/expiry conditions; restoring it must not grant skills or memories acquired after its last update.
An activated copy is an independent nonplayer character with its own subsequent development; the player controls only one character and shared initial identity must not share mutable ledgers.
Copies are not automatically allies; friendship purchases and hostile-copy consequences use the appropriate social traits and explicit authored relationship decisions.
Taking over a surviving copy after death requires campaign permission and preserves that copy's independently changed skills, traits and memories.
An involuntary supernatural infection applies the resulting ancestry template and adjusts character value through event-acquisition rules.
A deliberately accepted beneficial supernatural transformation follows the modification payment policy; any additional disadvantages used to meet its price are explicit authorized traits.
Ordinary death ends the character's career; creating a replacement is distinct from restoring an identical state or consuming an extra-life benefit.
A permitted resurrection resumes the same character under the specified intervention rules; do not automatically rebuild starting inventory or reset advancement records.
Returning as a different kind of body uses mind-transfer composition and the supernatural-affliction price policy, combining retained mental traits with the new physical form.
A campaign modification definition declares permitted trait changes, provider qualifications, payment mode, recovery, failed outcomes and consent status before execution.

A complication interface identifies the operated body part, critical-failure damage and permitted resulting trait changes; validate cost and incompatibilities and preserve the decision in the treatment record.
An authored copy history specifies acquired or lost traits, investment changes and relationships since duplication; expose these differences before a player adopts that copy.
Replacement-character policy declares its allowed budget and creation constraints; prior character death does not authorize cloning the deceased sheet for free.

exclusions.reason: Exclude named fictional examples, artwork and explanatory prose. Retain mechanical examples, optional procedures and specific campaign decisions as neutral requirements.
Approximate yearly and semester outcomes illustrate elapsed study rates; they are not additional automatic point awards.
